name: Mohammad Abdul Zinati
detail: Gaza City, 15 September 2026. Eyewitnesses told the Guardian he had gone to check on the body of a man struck by an Israeli bomb moments earlier; a second strike killed him

name: Sharif Shadi Labad
detail: Injured by the first strike. The Israeli military told the Guardian he was a Hamas militant and had been targeted

name: The wife and children of Mahmoud Hammad
detail: Killed, with his brother, his brother's wife and their children, in an Israeli airstrike on their home in Gaza City. He searches the rubble for their bones, January 2026 (AP; their names are not given)

name: 112 members of the Hassayna and Abu Sharia families
detail: Killed with some 300 others when an Israeli strike flattened a residential block in Sabra, Gaza City, in November 2023. Their remains were recovered from the rubble and buried on 4 August 2026; more are still under it (AP; Middle East Eye)

name: 112 members of the Hassayna and Abu Sharia families
detail: Killed with some 300 others when an Israeli strike flattened a residential block in Sabra, Gaza City, in November 2023. Their remains were recovered from the rubble and buried on 4 August 2026; more are still under it (AP; Middle East Eye)

name: 25 people killed overnight in Bureij and Nuseirat
detail: Five children and seven women among them, received by al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital, Deir al-Balah, 28 December 2023 (hospital records, via AP)

name: 16 people killed in Maghazi, Nuseirat, Deir al-Balah and Khan Younis
detail: Israeli strikes, 22 August 2024. Among the 15 brought to al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital were three children and a woman; a child was also killed in Khan Younis (hospital officials and AP journalists' count)

name: Two people killed near a tent camp in Khan Younis
detail: Israeli strike, 29 July 2026; more than 16 wounded (Nasser hospital and Palestinian Red Crescent, via AP)

name: At least eight people killed across Gaza on 2 August 2026
detail: Two children among them. In southern Gaza a strike on an apartment killed three members of one family, including their four-year-old child (local health officials and Nasser hospital, via AP)

name: Seven people killed in Jabaliya refugee camp
detail: Israeli airstrike on a market area, 14 July 2026; one woman among them, and Colonel Mohamad Marwan Salem, head of the Jabaliya police station, per Gaza's interior ministry (Shifa hospital officials, via AP)

name: More than 400 people killed across Gaza on 18 March 2025
detail: The day Israel resumed the war. In Jabaliya, Fahmi Mohammad said ten of his cousins were killed (Gaza Health Ministry and AP)

name: Dozens buried in the grounds of Nasser Hospital
detail: Khan Younis, January 2024, when the Israeli offensive made the cemetery too dangerous to reach (NBC News)

name: The dead of a November 2023 strike on a building in Nuseirat
detail: Their remains, still being recovered from the rubble by Gaza's civil defence in September 2026 (Roya News)

name: A member of Gaza's civil defence
detail: Critically injured in an Israeli airstrike near Abu Sharkh roundabout, brought to al-Shifa Hospital, 1 September 2026 (Roya News; name not given)

name: Five people struck by a US Hellfire missile in Iraq
detail: 28 March 2008. The US Army said they were placing a roadside bomb; its release gives no names and does not say what became of them (DVIDS)

name: People in a convoy struck near Habbaniyah, Iraq
detail: 29 June 2016. The US-led coalition said they were Da'esh fighters fleeing Fallujah; its release gives no names or count (DVIDS)
